title: Dock
drDigitalIntro:
The dock is the row of icons at the bottom of the screen.
• Each icon is a shortcut to open an app.
• Click an icon once to open that app.
• When an app is open, a small dot appears below its icon.
• You can also minimize a window here to tuck it away without closing it.
• Let's practice: open Notes from the dock, then close it.

playgroundTask.goal: Open and close an app from the dock

steps.say: Click Notes in the dock to open it.
Close it with the red X button.
Now click Browser in the dock.
Close it with the red X button.

drDigitalSuccess: You opened and closed apps from the dock — you're getting the hang of it!
drDigitalHint: Find the dock at the bottom of the playground. Click a glowing icon to open the app, then close it with the X at the top of the window.
